name: Poland — Polish parties
intro: compare it with Polish political parties
inclusion_note: The test includes the main national parties of Poland: those represented in the parliament (Sejm) and those with a significant national following. Positions are the team's estimates and are open to review.
hemicycle_note: Seats in the parliament (Sejm) after the 2023 election, arranged left to right. Approximate. 460 members. Parties shown without seats are included because they poll strongly.

Razem.name: Partia Razem
Razem.priorities: Affordable housing, Public services, Workers' rights and wages
Razem.description: Left Together, a democratic-socialist party that left the Lewica alliance in 2024; pro-NATO and pro-Ukraine, unlike much of Europe's radical left.

Lewica.name: Nowa Lewica
Lewica.priorities: Affordable housing, Public healthcare, Civil liberties
Lewica.description: The Left, a social-democratic party in Donald Tusk's coalition government.

Volt.name: Volt Polska
Volt.priorities: Deeper European integration, Climate action, Digital innovation, Democratic reform
Volt.description: National chapter of Volt Europa, the first pan-European party. All chapters share one programme: a federal and more democratic EU, evidence-based policy, a market economy with a strong welfare state, and the digital and climate transitions. Volt has the same positions in every country in this test.

P2050.name: Polska 2050
P2050.priorities: Climate action, Education, Rule of law
P2050.description: Poland 2050, a centrist party founded by TV presenter Szymon Hołownia, part of the governing coalition.

KO.name: Koalicja Obywatelska
KO.priorities: Rule of law, Defence and support for Ukraine, Deeper European integration, Security and law and order
KO.description: Civic Coalition of Prime Minister Donald Tusk, pro-European, focused on restoring the rule of law and on defence.

PSL.name: Polskie Stronnictwo Ludowe
PSL.priorities: Farmers and rural areas, Defence and support for Ukraine, Regions and rural services
PSL.description: Polish People's Party, an agrarian Christian-democratic party whose leader is defence minister.

PiS.name: Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
PiS.ideologies: National conservatism, Social conservatism, Soft Euroscepticism
PiS.priorities: Traditional family values, National sovereignty, Defence and support for Ukraine, Welfare state
PiS.description: Law and Justice, which governed from 2015 to 2023; national-conservative with generous family benefits, in conflict with the EU over judicial reforms.

Konfederacja.name: Konfederacja Wolność i Niepodległość
Konfederacja.priorities: Lower taxes, Less red tape, National sovereignty, Reducing immigration
Konfederacja.description: Confederation, an alliance of free-market libertarians and nationalists, popular with young men.

KKP.name: Konfederacja Korony Polskiej
KKP.priorities: National sovereignty, Christian values, Diplomacy with Russia, no arms deliveries
KKP.description: Confederation of the Polish Crown of Grzegorz Braun, a far-right, monarchist and strongly anti-EU party.
